method: Author self-score from bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg: orthographic EEVEE renders (AgX, the fixed shared light rig, not tuned to the score) of the low-poly model at the concept sheet's front, side and back angles, framed at the sheet's own scale (2.1 m over 806 sheet pixels), judged side by side against the sheet crops, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine (three.js 0.186.1, headless Chromium on ANGLE Metal, Apple M4, with the runtime D11 glow look; glow-close is the seat camera narrowed to the upper body). This pass followed the independent review (68/100) and its top fixes: clenched fists (each finger is a forward-pointing knuckle block, a front segment and a tucked tip with dark creases over a gunmetal core, and a thumb wrapped across the index and middle fingers), a taller head capsule (10.7 cm above the band's back rim, sheet 11 cm) with a raised face plate whose edges are the sheet's seams and the eyes on them, domed pauldron caps overhanging the drums by 2.3 cm with a smaller bezel, hub and emerald boss, darker bellows pleats, the back strap bent into the sheet's arc, the front grille thinned to six slots between five 2.4 cm bars, the bellows tapered to the sheet's narrower bottom, and brass normal scale 0.06. Engine colour medians (idle shot, the spec's boxes and masks): upper-body brass sRGB (118, 92, 54), hue 36, S 0.54, V 0.46 (concept 154, 111, 57); barrel walnut (83, 55, 36), V 0.33 (concept 68, 42, 27); bellows pleats (53, 42, 31), V 0.21 (concept 44, 28, 23, V 0.17; the previous build 86, 56, 39, V 0.34); front grille glow (245, 193, 82); eyes (237, 175, 83); glow-close grille (247, 194, 76), with the slots either side of the centre bar at (248, 206, 79). Vent: the chimney flame plume on the sheet is not modeled. p5-automatons-design.md models the vent as an emissive chimney mouth only and the art bible rules out smoke, so each mouth carries a glowing ember dome instead; this is a design-note deviation, not a fidelity gap.
gaps: The arms hang close to vertical from the side; the sheet angles the forearms forward more strongly, with the fists ahead of the knees (moving the elbow and wrist needs bone changes, not made this pass).
The fingers are rounded blocks rather than the sheet's flat-faced plates, and the thumb hooks slightly proud of the fingers with a dark gap under it from the seated view.
The pauldrons are domed drums turning about the shoulder axis; the sheet's shoulder plates sit off-axis over the shoulder, which the attack raise rules out without clavicle animation.
The legs remain slimmer than the sheet's, the knees lack the sheet's large round joint with an emerald seen from the front, and the pelvis is a plain gunmetal bulge.

The brass is about 20% darker and less saturated than the sheet's in the engine (median V 0.46 against 0.60), the barrel walnut is about 20% lighter, and the pleats are greyer (hue 30, S 0.42 against hue 14, S 0.48) because the environment specular dominates their vertex colour.
The walnut and brass are factor-only or the shared tileable set: no plank grain, wear or engraving as painted on the sheet.
In the EEVEE compare renders the grilles read pale because the D11 glow ramp is runtime-only; the engine shots show the intended amber core.
